editions.title: Last week in motorsport
editions.intro: A busy Sunday of racing on 13 September saw action across Formula 1, Formula 2, Formula 3, MotoGP, NASCAR Cup Series and the World Rally Championship.

items.headline: Spanish Grand Prix
items.body: Andrea Kimi Antonelli won the Spanish Grand Prix for Mercedes, ahead of Max Verstappen for Red Bull and Lando Norris for McLaren.

items.headline: Madrid
items.body: The Formula 2 round was held in Madrid.

items.headline: Madrid
items.body: Formula 3 action also took place in Madrid.

items.headline: Grand Prix of San Marino
items.detail: Misano World Circuit Marco Simoncelli, San Marino · Sun 13 Sep
items.body: Marc Marquez won the Grand Prix of San Marino for Ducati Lenovo Team, with Alex Marquez for BK8 Gresini Racing MotoGP and Pedro Acosta for Red Bull KTM Factory Racing following him.

items.headline: Enjoy Illinois 300
items.detail: World Wide Technology Raceway · Sun 13 Sep
items.body: The Enjoy Illinois 300 was held at World Wide Technology Raceway.

items.headline: Rally Chile
items.body: Rally Chile took place in Concepcion.
